claims.summary: Over F2 let Boolean degree-D PC pseudoideal J, weight degree<=b, M,h>=1 fixed tuples degree<=delta>=1, K>=0,R>=1, and b+K+max((h+2)delta,(h+1)delta+hR,2R)<=D. Each parent has h fair independent scalar/auxiliary row coins; conditional on locations its scalar rows are independent uniform binary input combinations, auxiliary coefficients have degree<=R, and across-parent correlations are allowed. Full P_a is scalar-only P_a^sc times auxiliary factors. On the SAME V_K, ker E_sc is contained in ker E_full, by paid absorption. With H=dim[wV_K] and m_a(L)=rank(f in V_L ->([w g_ai f])_i), E rank E_full <=min(H,2^-h sum_a sum_j=0^h binom(h,j)2^-j m_a(K+j delta)) <=min(H,(3/4)^h sum_a m_a(K+h delta)). Includes the half-scalar/half-star law but does not reset original source costs or pay for auxiliary rows in the scalar numerator. Composition of scalar prefix enlargement and deterministic factor multiplication. In recorded charged cut-code range r>=m/3,delta>=12,K+h delta<=min(D,m/16), weight1, replacing m_a by h0 yields normalized expression >=M(1/2+(17/16)^delta/4)^h>1. The old actual-tuple control similarly makes the true binomial tuple expression >=(M/3^delta)(1/2+(17/16)^delta/4)^h>1 for M>=3^delta and its full source margins. Yet when K>=delta the same control's supported common-input clamp has surviving f=z0 and deficient completed mixed rank. Thus failure of this sufficient bound is not failure of the mixed law or a rank lower bound. General actual-source coverage and the Frege goal remain open.
